manaNeeded: {2}{W}, plus an additional {W} if Glorious Protector was not foretold
description:
Cast Glorious Protector by paying {2}{W}{W}.
When Glorious Protector enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Abdel Adrian until Glorious Protector leaves the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, ending its effect, causing Touch the Spirit Realm to return from exile to the battlefield.
When Touch the Spirit Realm enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Glorious Protector until Touch the Spirit Realm leaves the battlefield.
When Glorious Protector leaves the battlefield, Abdel Adrian returns from exile to the battlefield.
When Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Touch the Spirit Realm and any number of other nonland permanents you control until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating at least one 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Touch the Spirit Realm leaves the battlefield, ending its effect, causing Glorious Protector to return to the battlefield from exile.
Repeat from step 2.
